cause: The read-only display script printed a UTF-8 JSON value containing U+2192 to the host cp1252 stdout. All subject reads were read-only; the script authored no files. A subsequent display used json.dumps(...,ensure_ascii=True) successfully.
resolution: Explicit UTF-8 decoding for reads and ASCII-safe JSON for tool summaries; immutable review outputs use explicit UTF-8 serialization.
